solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bank where one can safely dive without first ending in slime

indicators.note: says the first of the matching letters is dropped from the pool phrase

parts.note: the deep end of a swimming pool is where diving is safe

indicators.note: the final letter of the word slime is the one wanted

explanation.surface: A description of a riverbank pool where diving is safe, apart from the slime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' is the verb, as in bank on. 'without first' removes the first E of DEEP END, the E being the 'ending in slime'.
explanation.definitionFit: To bank on something is to rely or count on it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Remove fat when dividing amount

indicators.note: the word for when splits the other piece in two

parts.note: a degree is an extent or amount
as can mean when, as in as he left

explanation.surface: Cutting the fat when portioning a quantity of food.
explanation.definitionFit: To degrease is to clean off grease or fatty deposits.

clue.text: Softly decline to be in the van

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for softly
to recede is to diminish or decline

explanation.surface: A quiet refusal to ride in the van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the van' is not a vehicle but the vanguard, the front.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in the vanguard is to go in front, to come before others.

clue.text: Open-air dancing in Holland is like none other

indicators.note: the dancing letters go inside the country code

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands

indicators.note: the letters of open-air jig about into a new order

explanation.surface: Outdoor dancing in the Netherlands is unique.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonpareil means having no equal, unrivalled.

clue.text: Seer welcoming son for poetic king …

indicators.note: a host welcoming a guest takes it inside, so the seer's word encloses the son

parts.note: a palmist claims to see the future in hands

explanation.surface: A fortune-teller taking in a boy on behalf of a king who writes verse.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this clue to the next, which also begins with a king.
explanation.definitionFit: King David, the traditional author of the Psalms, is called the Psalmist: a poet who was king.

clue.text: Ringlets debase tailored style of jacket

indicators.note: the letters are cut and sewn into a new shape

explanation.surface: Curly hair spoils a well-cut jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: A jacket with one row of buttons and a narrow overlap is this cut.

clue.text: Ostentatious vehicle carrying bachelor to dance

indicators.note: the car holds the bachelor inside it

parts.note: a limo, a stretch limousine, is a showy car

explanation.surface: A flashy car takes a single man to a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The limbo is a Caribbean dance under a lowering bar.

clue.text: Devise international colour supplement in Spain

parts.note: a Sunday colour supplement is a magazine, a mag
E is the vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: Planning a worldwide glossy magazine edition for Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine is to conceive or invent in the mind, to devise.

clue.text: Dirty shirt (one a month)

indicators.note: a dirty shirt is messed up, so its letters are jumbled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A shirt worn once a month and grubby.
explanation.definitionFit: Tishri is the seventh month of the Jewish calendar, in autumn.

clue.text: Kind of garment that's worth 5/5?

parts.note: 5/5 is read as two of the 5-down jackets, so two singles make a double

explanation.walkthrough: A coat 'worth' two of 5-down is twice single-breasted: the double version.
explanation.definitionFit: A jacket with a wide overlap and two rows of buttons is the double-buttoned cut.

clue.text: … king with brass instrument following even as raw youth

indicators.note: says the instrument comes after the other pieces

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
e'en is the poetic contraction of even
a horn is a brass instrument

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: a king with a trumpet-like instrument, oddly described as a raw youth.
explanation.walkthrough: E'EN is the poetic shortening of 'even', fitting the 'poetic king' carried over by the ellipsis.
explanation.definitionFit: A greenhorn is an inexperienced newcomer, someone young and untried.

clue.text: Pecuniary resources of little value leading to distress finally

parts.note: mean can describe something poor or paltry

indicators.note: takes only the closing letter of the word distress

explanation.surface: Having little money worth anything ends up causing distress.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's means are their money and income, their financial resources.

clue.text: Pet we blame for running wild

indicators.note: the letters of we blame break loose and settle into a new order

explanation.surface: We blame our pet animal for running amok.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewe lamb is a cherished pet, as in Nathan's parable of the poor man's only lamb.

clue.text: Throne room column becoming more unbalanced

parts.note: the throne is a jokey name for a toilet, so the room is the loo
a pier is a supporting pillar

explanation.surface: A pillar in a royal throne room is getting wobbly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throne room' suggests royalty but means a toilet (LOO).
explanation.definitionFit: Loopy means crazy, so loopier means crazier, more unbalanced in mind.

clue.text: Part of act appreciated by audience

indicators.note: an audience hears, so the word is taken as spoken

parts.note: to have seen something is to have taken it in or understood it

explanation.surface: A bit of a play that the audience enjoyed.
explanation.definitionFit: Plays divide into acts and each act into smaller units, the scenes.

clue.text: Expressed in small space, smell faded away

parts.note: an em is a printer's unit of space
BO is body odour
a sound or light that died faded away

explanation.surface: In a cramped room a bad smell gradually disappeared.
explanation.definitionFit: An idea embodied in something is given concrete form, made manifest or expressed.

clue.text: An oil unusually absorbed by dexterous stripper

indicators.note: the shuffled letters are soaked up inside the skilful word

parts.note: deft means skilful with the hands

indicators.note: the letters of an oil appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A nimble striptease artist soaks up some oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stripper' is not a performer but a chemical that strips leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A defoliant is a chemical sprayed to strip plants of their leaves.

clue.text: Setbacks concerning poetry

parts.note: re means about or concerning
verses are poetry

explanation.surface: Disappointments to do with poems.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverses are misfortunes or defeats, things that set one back.

clue.text: Wrongly foretell no charge

indicators.note: the letters of foretell are set down wrongly, in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A fortune-teller's mistaken prediction made without a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A toll-free call or road costs nothing to use, so carries no charge.

clue.text: Result of old notes about company

indicators.note: the notes go round the company

parts.note: ut and me are two notes of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: The upshot of some old musical notes about a business.
explanation.walkthrough: UT is the old name for doh, and ME a variant of mi.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is the result or consequence of something.

clue.text: Sergeant perhaps abandons dance for love

indicators.note: the sergeant walks out of the dance, taking his letters with him

parts.note: the flamenco is a Spanish dance
a sergeant is an example of an NCO, a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: A soldier leaves a dance for the sake of romance.
explanation.definitionFit: An old flame is a former sweetheart, someone one loves.

clue.text: Wantonness wearing a ring?

parts.note: a band is a ring, such as a wedding band
something worn is on

explanation.surface: Is putting on a ring a sign of loose behaviour?
explanation.walkthrough: Someone wearing a ring has 'a band on'.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandon is uninhibited freedom of manner, a lack of restraint.

clue.text: Make a speech about knight being decorated

indicators.note: the speech goes around the knight

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: Giving a speech about a knight receiving an honour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decorated' suggests a medal, but means elaborately adorned.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornate means elaborately adorned, highly embellished.

clue.text: Wine remains to develop with time for bit of maturity

indicators.note: the letters are left to develop into a new arrangement
time stands in place of the other letter
only the opening letter of maturity is meant

explanation.surface: A wine is kept back to develop and given time to mature.
explanation.walkthrough: In REMAINS, T (time) replaces M ('bit of maturity'), giving RETAINS, which 'to develop' then rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Retsina is a Greek white wine flavoured with pine resin.

clue.text: It's clumsy to splash paint

indicators.note: splashed paint lands in a jumble, so its letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Splashing paint is a careless act.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means unsuitable or lacking skill, hence awkward.

clue.text: Border with herb surrounding more than half of gnomes

indicators.note: the herb is placed around the other piece

parts.note: sage is a culinary herb

indicators.note: three of the five letters are kept, the last two dropped

parts.note: gnomes and elves are both small folk of legend

explanation.surface: A garden edge planted with herbs around most of the gnome ornaments.
explanation.definitionFit: A selvage is the woven edge of a fabric that stops it fraying, a border.

clue.text: A memory stored with a scent

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in computing

explanation.surface: A smell can be stored in the memory.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a pleasant smell, a synonym of scent.

clue.text: He meets Democratic American groups in opposition

parts.note: he refers to a man, so the pronoun stands for the man
US abbreviates the United States, so American

explanation.surface: A man meets a Democrat from America and they are on opposite sides.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a divided outlook in which two camps face off against each other.

clue.text: There's fish after function for end of day

indicators.note: the fish comes after the function

parts.note: a social function is an event
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Fish is served after a social function to close the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventide is a literary word for evening, the close of the day.

clue.text: Stretches of colour on board

indicators.note: being on a vessel means being inside it, so the colour goes within the ship

parts.note: a board here is a ship's deck, read as the steamship abbreviation
a tint is a shade of colour

explanation.surface: Bands of colour painted on a board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is a crossword convention: put the piece inside SS (steamship).
explanation.definitionFit: A stint is a period of work or duty, a stretch of time.
